meta.name: abstract-invariant-generator
meta.description: Uses abstract interpretation to automatically infer loop invariants, function preconditions, and postconditions for formal verification. Generates invariants that capture program behavior and support correctness proofs in Dafny, Isabelle, Coq, and other verification systems. Use when adding formal specifications to code, generating verification conditions, inferring contracts for functions, or discovering loop invariants for proofs.

copy.tagline: 自动推断循环不变量和函数契约，辅助形式化验证。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Dafny、Coq 等工具中为代码添加形式化规约。
